rfm_tuples.M_value: Q1'26 operating income $123.7M vs Q1'25 $139.4M = -$15.7M / -11.3% YoY decline despite revenue +6.8%. Pretax income $107.8M vs $120.7M = -10.7%. Driver of operating margin compression: salaries +$44.8M (+11.9%) on the 14% block-hour growth from 2025 finally hitting the captain-cost base; fuel +$14.4M (+58.8%) — note SKYW is reimbursed for capacity-purchase fuel but bears the prorate/SWC exposure; airport-related expenses +$8.3M (+30%).

Mode B catch: management does not explicitly quantify the policy benefit in dollars, only the directional 'partially offset by new aircraft' framing.

summary: SKYW is a -31.4% drawdown name where the FORENSIC tape directly OPPOSES the LONG/honest-management thesis: ZERO open-market insider purchases (code P) over the 12-month drawdown window vs $18.93M of insider SALES, of which $16.08M is by named C-suite officers — CEO Childs $4.73M, CFO Simmons $3.78M, CCO Steel $6.52M. The pattern is asymmetric AND clustered: five officers sold within 5 days of the 2025-07-24 Q2 earnings 8-K (combined $9.45M at ~$117 — the local high), and CCO Steel sold $0.79M one day after the 2026-02-17 10-K filing and another $2.20M one week after. Personal stakes shrank materially: CEO Childs -28% (553K -> 397K shares), CCO Steel -50% (154K -> 77K). Company was simultaneously buying back stock with shareholder capital ($101M at avg ~$98 across Q4'25-Q1'26), effectively providing the bid into which officers exited. On disclosure quality the issuer is honest: covenants clean, no going-concern flag, $627M cash vs $550M 2026 debt maturity, $940M FY25 CFO, EY clean opinion ratified at the May 5, 2026 annual meeting. Q1'26 headline EPS +3.3% is misleading vs operating income -11.3% (entire net-income beat comes from a $14.1M discrete tax benefit dropping the effective rate from 16.7% to 5.6%). FY2025 D&A was further flattered by a Q4 2024 useful-life extension on the CRJ700/CRJ550 fleet (-$19.4M D&A). Verdict: SHORT-tier. The insider-vs-narrative test produces the cleanest negative signal Signal-OS can extract — structurally identical to the ABG LONG case but with the opposite sign, against a -31% drawdown that management has had every opportunity to fade with personal cash and has not.
